proposed.explanation: Stepped ziggurats are Mesopotamian forms, not typical of Hittite architecture. Hypostyle halls are Egyptian and Persian forms; Hittite temples were typically smaller and inward-facing. While Hittites did build fortifications, the Temple of Yazılıkaya is a religious structure carved into rock, not a fortress. The Temple of Yazılıkaya near Boğazköy (c. 1250 BCE) carved into a natural rock outcrop, with sculpted reliefs of gods and the king.
